scope: Public metadata catalog of built-in IP and DNS feed sources only
runtime_semantics: Source topic is descriptive. category_id is canonical from packaged site-rating-derived Pankratis taxonomy. Local source overrides feed matching to DNS/Web filters; profile-specific policy remains independently configured. Unmatched source topics remain Unknown.
licensing: Links and factual source metadata only. Third-party feed bodies are NOT mirrored here. Users must review each provider's redistribution, commercial/OEM, API and rate-limit terms.

source_candidates.label: Malicious TLS certificate SHA-1
source_candidates.notes: Requires visibility of full server certificate; TLS 1.3 passive visibility is limited. No blind Block from certificate hash. Last inspected public CSV snapshot had August 2026 data; do not equate feed availability with current freshness.

source_candidates.label: Malware-associated JA3 client fingerprints
source_candidates.notes: The available CSV header reports last update 2021-08-03 despite site text about feed generation every 5 minutes. Historic malware JA3 only; no current-threat/auto-Block claim. Provider warns of significant false positives.

source_candidates.label: Certificate-associated C2 IP and port metadata
source_candidates.notes: Different from IP-only W011 feed: preserve port and recency; never infer whole-IP block from port-scoped evidence.

source_candidates.label: JA4 reputation/application mapping
source_candidates.notes: Do not use stale unofficial snapshots or assume public bulk API. JA4 TLS client fingerprint algorithm is BSD-3-Clause; JA4DB access and JA4+ usage are separate rights.

source_candidates.label: JA4 TLS Client fingerprint specification
source_candidates.notes: Algorithm reference, not a blacklist. JA4S/JA4H/JA4X/JARM are NOT JA4 client inputs or interchangeable.

source_candidates.label: C2 server-side JARM enrichment discovery
source_candidates.notes: No vetted, licensed current canonical daily endpoint; JARM requires separate server-side matcher, unsupported by existing client JA4 path.

source_candidates.label: DB-IP Country Lite CSV/MMDB
source_candidates.notes: GeoIP is classification, not malware reputation; monthly Lite database has reduced coverage. CC BY 4.0 attribution applies.

source_candidates.label: DB-IP ASN Lite CSV/MMDB
source_candidates.notes: ASN is contextual policy, not a malicious IP feed. Preserve origin ASN and refresh-date attribution.

source_candidates.label: GeoLite2 Country / ASN reference
source_candidates.notes: Account and EULA required; refresh/expiration requirements. Not an automatically accessible URL.

source_candidates.label: Malware URL-associated DNS RPZ
source_candidates.notes: RPZ may be IP-based or host-based; preserve record type. Excludes major shared domains in provider policy. URL-level feed must not be reduced to blind whole-domain block.

source_candidates.label: Active malware URLs (exact path)
source_candidates.notes: Exact URL evidence only; path may be encrypted on HTTPS. Avoid blocking whole CDN/domain from a single malicious path.

source_candidates.label: Time-scoped C2 and malware IOC API
source_candidates.notes: Auth-Key required; APIs expire IOCs older than six months; commercial API may require subscription. Separate IP/domain/ip:port/hash types.

source_candidates.label: ThreatFox domain/IP RPZ export
source_candidates.notes: Auth-Key required; distinguish domain from IP record, not a general category list.

source_candidates.label: Verified online phishing URLs
source_candidates.notes: Hourly database; registered app key and descriptive User-Agent advised; URL evidence not automatically domain-wide.

source_candidates.label: OpenPhish Community phishing URL feed
source_candidates.notes: Community feed refreshed every 12 hours, limited and subject to terms; do not use unofficial openphish.eu impostor sites.

source_candidates.label: Unified hosts blocklist (non-C2 topics)
source_candidates.notes: General ads/trackers rather than verified malware C2. Existing stevenblack-fakenews is a different variant. Keep DNS category scope and source attribution.

source_candidates.label: ET Open Suricata ruleset
source_candidates.notes: Suricata-update et/open should resolve versioned rules; Pankratis must test supported subset, count rejected rules, SID collisions, flowbits and licenses; never auto-import as Block.

source_candidates.label: Snort 3 Community Rules (GPLv2)
source_candidates.notes: GPLv2 community pack, not registered/subscriber rules. Snort3 language is not fully Suricata-compatible; validate each SID and dependencies, not blind conversion. Proposed direct archive path has not been independently fetched; use documented official download page until endpoint URL is validated.

source_candidates.label: Suricata JA3 rules
source_candidates.notes: JA3 signatures are high false-positive; do not enable default Drop or compile unsupported JA3 keywords without typed shared TLS evidence.

source_candidates.label: Suricata TLS certificate rules
source_candidates.notes: Choose one of tls.fingerprint or tls_cert_fingerprint variants, not both; depends on actual certificate visibility.

source_candidates.label: Suricata botnet C2 IP:port rules
source_candidates.notes: Feodo IP feed already in legacy IP catalog; this is the separate IDS rule representation. Do not double count shared evidence.

source_candidates.label: Exact-URL Suricata IDS rules
source_candidates.notes: Only exact HTTP URLs; HTTPS ciphertext may prevent matching. Source rule import must preserve source rights and supported subset.

source_candidates.label: ThreatFox generated Suricata C2 rules
source_candidates.notes: IOC type, expiry and SID namespaces must be preserved; do not double block via TI IP feed.

source_candidates.label: suricata-update community source registry
source_candidates.notes: This is discovery/transport metadata, NOT a ruleset itself. Avoid duplicating et/open and sslbl/rules as independent detections.

source_candidates.label: Malware sample SHA-256 metadata lookup
source_candidates.notes: Current Pankratis has no full file reassembly/AV verdict; no live hash blocking. Never fetch malicious sample binaries or assume cloud lookup in packet fast path.

source_candidates.label: CIRCL MISP OSINT feed
source_candidates.notes: MISP event feed is not automatically STIX/TAXII. Requires typed conversion, provenance, TLP/rights and event dedup.

source_candidates.label: MISP default OSINT feeds index
source_candidates.notes: Directory of different source providers, formats and terms; source-by-source authorization required, no automatic ingest of all feeds.

source_candidates.label: OTX community pulse indicators
source_candidates.notes: Requires X-OTX-API-KEY; community pulse IoCs are unverified attribution until independently corroborated. OTX also supports TAXII path.

source_candidates.label: Tor official bulk exit list (alternative source)
source_candidates.notes: Alternative to existing tor (dan.me.uk) feed, not another independent confidence vote. Exit node status is not maliciousness; block only as explicit operator policy.

source_candidates.label: SSH-specific recently reported attacker IPs
source_candidates.notes: Subset of existing debl all.txt; no independent corroboration. 48h observed sources, false positives possible; never blanket high-confidence C2 label.

source_candidates.label: Multi LIGHT — balanced low-breakage ads & tracking
source_candidates.notes: Lower-overhead option. Hierarchical family: choose ONE of Light, Normal, PRO, PRO Mini; do not stack. Contains ads/tracking plus some security sources. Provider allows raw feeds under GPL-3.0; redistribution and source provenance require compliance.

source_candidates.label: Multi NORMAL — standard ads & tracking
source_candidates.notes: Balanced all-round DNS adblock, larger than Light. One Multi tier only, do not stack other Multi levels or duplicate confidence with aggregated sources.

source_candidates.label: Multi PRO Mini — resource-conscious ads/tracking
source_candidates.notes: Optimized subset of PRO for limited RAM, with more aggressive tracking rules than Normal. PRO Mini is an alternative to PRO, never additive; must preserve ABP exception semantics.

source_candidates.label: Multi PRO — broader ads/tracking, breakage possible
source_candidates.notes: Broader list; may block crash/error telemetry and interfere with legitimate apps. Alternative to Light, Normal and PRO Mini; choose only one tier. Not a malicious-domain verdict feed.

source_candidates.label: oisd small — ads-focused, low-breakage DNS list
source_candidates.notes: Official ABP domain list. Tested endpoint HTTP 200 text/plain on 2026-11-09; 61,262 entries reported by 2026-11-08 header. OISD Big includes Small: pick one. Content may aggregate other upstream lists; do not count as independent reputation source.

source_candidates.label: oisd big — expanded ads, malware & tracking DNS list
source_candidates.notes: Official ABP domain list. Tested endpoint HTTP 200 text/plain on 2026-11-09. Superset of oisd small, so never stack both. More domains and legitimate-site breakage risk; not proof of malware.

source_candidates.label: 1Hosts Lite — balanced DNS ad/tracker domains
source_candidates.notes: Official plain-domain feed; last-modified in header was 2026-09-03, with about 203k rules (may be older than other candidates). Xtra beta is more disruptive; do not auto-enable. Check freshness before any admission. MPL-2.0 repo license; upstream source rights still require review.

source_candidates.label: AdAway hosts — Android/mobile ad and analytics networks
source_candidates.notes: Mobile-app ad/tracker hosts. Source header explicitly states CC BY 3.0; deduplicate against StevenBlack unified and other aggregators. Do not import localhost entries as blocked remote IPs; extract valid domains only.

source_candidates.label: Peter Lowe adservers — curated advertising and tracking domains
source_candidates.notes: Known hand-curated list with ~3.5k domains as of Oct 2026. Verified URL returns HTTP 200 text/plain. Format is localhost hosts rows. Source is included by StevenBlack aggregator, so not independent confidence; commercial rights/attribution must be reviewed.

source_candidates.label: Human-edited website directory and topic hierarchy
source_candidates.notes: Approx 2.9 million curated website entries; website TSV joined to category hierarchy TSV by ID. Source published with attribution requirements. URL paths and ancestor categories must not be naively converted to all subdomains. Directory entries may be stale; compare first-party evidence before promotion.

source_candidates.label: ROR research/education/health institution website registry
source_candidates.notes: Official research-organization IDs, websites and organization types. Only verified institution website hosts map to Education & Academia/Science & Research/Healthcare according to type; never infer entire parent domain from one path or institutional alias. Avoid double voting with OpenAlex and Wikidata.

source_candidates.label: OpenAlex institution homepages and organization types
source_candidates.notes: Institution homepage_url and type from OpenAlex often derive from ROR; correlated evidence, not independent confidence votes. Academic organizations, hospitals and research institutions only; metadata not a generic web-category list.

source_candidates.label: Cloudflare Radar/Security Center domain content and threat categories
source_candidates.notes: Content categories and security/risk classifications are distinct; availability, API access and redistribution rights must be verified. Cloudflare Radar top-domain rankings already used for discovery in site-rating-app, NOT content categories. No bulk endpoint asserted.

source_candidates.label: IAB Content Taxonomy 3.1 topic labels and hierarchy
source_candidates.notes: Useful as versioned category-vocabulary crosswalk, NOT a per-domain label feed. Do not infer new site classifications merely from taxonomy terms; latest Content Taxonomy 3.1 differs from 2.x, mapping requires review.

source_candidates.label: OpenStreetMap listed business websites with shop/amenity/tourism tags
source_candidates.notes: Only owner-linked website tags, not IP/CDN hostnames. ODbL share-alike and produced-database conditions require legal review before redistribution/merger; local business types are weak hints for domain primary purpose.

domain_category_evidence.label: UT1 Toulouse topic categorization
domain_category_evidence.notes: Use mapped category as hint; lists not all equally maintained; primary actively maintained category is adult. Existing pipeline already maps numerous UT1 labels.

domain_category_evidence.label: Block List Project lists
domain_category_evidence.source_license: Unlicense stated by project; upstream attribution review
domain_category_evidence.notes: Existing adapter already has categories for advertising, malware, phishing, piracy, gambling, social platforms, telemetry. Aggregate outputs include upstream lists; avoid duplicate confidence and automatic Block.

domain_category_evidence.label: v2fly domain-list-community geosite categories
domain_category_evidence.source_license: MIT claimed by existing pipeline; validate upstream per-list
domain_category_evidence.notes: Already used for media/games/social/ecommerce/finance/education/cryptocurrency signals. Region, geolocation and routing lists are not content categories.

domain_category_evidence.label: Wikidata official websites and entities
domain_category_evidence.notes: Already integrated; new ROR and OpenAlex records often overlap entity IDs and must not be counted as independent validation.

domain_category_evidence.label: Cloudflare Radar top-domain ranking
domain_category_evidence.notes: A top-rank is NOT a genre or quality label; Cloudflare per-domain category lookup is separate and not yet supported.

domain_category_evidence.label: Tranco ranked domains
domain_category_evidence.notes: Popularity ranking is not an editorial category.

extended_registry.consumer_gate: Existing IP/DNS feed adapters read ip_feeds/dns_feeds only; candidates are read-only information until individually adapted, licensed, tested and explicitly admitted
extended_registry.taxonomy_scope: feed signal/purpose is separate from website's primary domain classification and detector capabilities
extended_registry.source_rights: all candidate rights and interfaces require independent review
